_comment: ZR_BrickWall: running-bond brick, 250 x 65 mm bricks; 8 x 28 bricks, 2.08 m per tile. The maps are empty on purpose: the main session uploads assets/textures/out/materials/ZR_MAT_BrickWall_Color.png, _Normal.png and _Rough.png and writes the three rbxassetid values here (never invent ids). World.applyWear skips this variant while ColorMap is empty, so nothing breaks before then.
